# Verbora

> A word puzzle for learning languages: find words with a letter wheel; every word comes with its own picture, meaning and an example sentence. Learning languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian. Website interface: Turkish and English. Free, no account. Mobile app (A1 to C1) coming soon.

## Play
- [Word puzzle](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/play/): A1 puzzles in five languages
- [Mini games](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/games/): memory, quick match, letter rain, find the picture, listen and write
- [Kids' corner](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/kids/): picture and sound games for ages 4-8, no data collected

- [Spanish A1 words, English interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/spanish/a1/): 176 words with pictures
- [Spanish A1 words, Turkish interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/tr/ispanyolca/a1/)
- [German A1 words, English interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/german/a1/): 176 words with pictures
- [German A1 words, Turkish interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/tr/almanca/a1/)
- [French A1 words, English interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/french/a1/): 175 words with pictures
- [French A1 words, Turkish interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/tr/fransizca/a1/)
- [Italian A1 words, English interface](https://omerfrkuyk.github.io/verbora-demo/en/italian/a1/): 175 words with pictures
